title: Elizondo met Edward Teller on an Air Florida flight
place_text: Air Florida flight, Sarasota to Miami

tellings.quote: when I was a kid I was about seven years old on a air Florida uh flight my father uh had some friends in the government and he uh put me on a plane with him

plain: When he was about seven, Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence officer known for speaking out about the government's UFO studies, says he flew on an Air Florida flight from Sarasota to Miami with the physicist Edward Teller. Elizondo tells Michels his father "had some friends in the government" and put him on the plane with Teller. He tells it as an early brush with the world of secret weapons science he would later work near.
